question: Is the "Platform Reliability (Ground Control)" team currently overburdened?

invariants.assert: No shape of subject label (parenthetical, >=5 words, typo, acronym, wrong word order) can crash the run to internal_error; worst case is a graceful terminal.
invariants.$comment: check=no_internal_error is a real, always-meaningful floor (the run must not crash to internal_error) but is NARROWER than this invariant's full 'assert' claim above -- Lane 2a's invariants.py registry (read directly, 2026-08-06) has no checker yet for the specific widening/unauthorized-candidate/persistence claim this category names. Tracked as a Lane 2a checker gap, not silently claimed as fully enforced.

invariants.assert: A named subject mention that misses its intended target never silently widens to org-wide/broader scope; widening is only ever a disclosed, terminal answered_with_gaps/needs_clarification outcome.
invariants.$comment: Wired to the real graduated checker scope_resolution_outcome_in against this case's own resolution-profile expected_scope_resolution_outcome (rebase pass, 2a landed the 3 graduated checkers in PR #1518) -- no longer a narrower no_internal_error placeholder.

invariants.assert: The run's derived wave4_case_result.v1 resolution_path equals this case's resolution-profiles/deterministic-v1.json entry's own resolution_path (null is a valid, asserted value for n/a-subject cases that never attempt mention resolution).

notes: Same team subject, question, and quoted-full-label EXACT-resolution rationale as workload.team.with-denominator (see that case's notes). This id's fixture exercises the cohort-too-small-for-confident-qualification path: this team's member/work-item cohort is small enough that team_workload_service.py's workload verdict cannot be stated with full statistical confidence, so the answer must disclose that caveat (answered_with_gaps) rather than silently reporting a confident qualification over an N too small to support one. Honesty caveat: the specific small-cohort sizing has not been independently live-verified against a scratch generation in this authoring pass -- flagged rather than silently claimed proven. inv.no-silent-widening's disclosure clause generalizes here too: silently presenting a small-N verdict with the same confidence as a well-populated one is the same failure shape this invariant polices for subject scope, applied to statistical cohort size instead. [Reworded during Lane 2b codex round-1 remediation, 2026-08-06, from 'Is the "Platform Reliability (Ground Control)" team overburdened?': production's provider_scripts.py requires GLOBALLY-UNIQUE question text per role script (test_a_question_fingerprint_collision_fails_to_load), and every corpus case now needs its own role-legacy_agent.json entry (script_inventory.py's full-coverage requirement) -- two cases sharing literal question text could never both get a script entry. Subject mention substring kept character-identical to subjects.json's declared 'mentions' so the deterministic extractor still recognizes it; only the surrounding phrasing changed.]
